# id: # Cooking methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Cooking sardines
where: Fire, with raw sardines bought from fishing shops
note: Buy raw sardines (10 coins each per the UIM guide) from Gerrant's Fishy Business and cook them on a fire; 40 xp each per the P2P fish table, no xp/h given.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Cooking training; Ironman Guide/Cooking; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking 2026-11-11

name: Early Cooking quests (Cook's Assistant, Gertrude's Cat)
note: Cook's Assistant (300 xp) and Gertrude's Cat (1,525 xp) are one-off rewards per the UIM guide, not xp/h; with two Recipe for Disaster subquests (1,000 xp each) they total 3,825 xp to level 18 (Ironman guide); quest names are in the note because they are the method, not prerequisites.
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking; Ironman Guide/Cooking 2026-11-11

name: Cooking trout and salmon
where: Barbarian Village fly fishing spots (permanent fire nearby) or Shilo Village
note: Trout gives 70 xp each (cook at 15) and salmon 90 (cook at 25) per the F2P guide, no xp/h given; FISHING 20 is for trout per the F2P guide; Shilo Village catches are cooked in Rogues' Den or Hosidius kitchen (Ironman guide).
source: OSRS Wiki Free-to-play Cooking training; Ironman Guide/Cooking; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking 2026-11-11

name: Baking pies with the Bake Pie spell
where: Anywhere you can cast Bake Pie
note: Each level is a different pie, from redberry (10) to summer pie (95); rates assume 1,885 pies/h plus 113,100 passive Magic xp/h and unlimited water and fire runes (page cites a steam battlestaff as an example); Magic level not stated on the page.

name: Cooking sweetcorn at Kastori ovens
where: Kastori sweetcorn plants and nearby ovens (or allotment sweetcorn from herb runs)
note: Ironman guide: up to 70,000 xp/h at level 54; sweetcorn grown in allotments and collected on herb runs is described as more efficient; membership of Kastori not stated on the page.

name: Baking cakes from an oak larder
where: Player-owned house, with a range in the house or outside the portal (Rimmington, Hosidius)
note: Ironman guide: about 50,000 xp/h at level 40 and 70,000 at level 60, with 500 cakes/h, very click-intensive; the oak larder needs Construction 33 (boostable); membership not stated.

name: Cooking servery food at the Mess
note: No supplies needed; meat pies at level 20 give about 48,000–55,000 xp/h, stews about 70,000–80,000 (UIM guide), and pineapple pizzas from level 65 give 150,000–200,000 xp/h (Ironman guide; UIM says up to 200,000); hop worlds between loads.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Cooking; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Cooking 2026-11-11

name: Making jugs of wine (grapes and jugs of water)
where: Anywhere with grapes and jugs of water (Cooks' Guild supplies are free)
note: Each wine gives 200 xp once the batch ferments after 12 s without making more; below level 68 a jug of bad wine gives 0 xp; 490,000 xp/h from level 68 (P2P guide) or 470,000–490,000 (F2P guide); Cooks' Guild needs 32 Cooking and a chef's hat; grapes best from Zulrah or Vorkath (Ironman guide).
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Cooking training; Free-to-play Cooking training; Ironman Guide/Cooking 2026-11-11

name: Making jugs of wine from noted grapes (UIM)
where: Anywhere with Humidify; sell wine at Arnold Lydspor's general store in Piscatoris
note: Noted grapes from Zulrah, Vorkath or the Kalphite Queen with Humidify-filled jugs; up to 280,000 xp/h, about 200,000 if fletching arrows; Dream Mentor is needed to cast Humidify, Swan Song is recommended for the store, and an Item Retrieval Service is advised; membership not stated.

name: Cooking lobsters at Hosidius kitchen
note: 120 xp each; the table gives an approx xp/h range of 120,000–165,000 without burns, lower bound used; cooking gauntlets (Family Crest rewards) are needed for optimal rates; Hosidius kitchen access needs the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary.

name: Cooking sharks at Hosidius kitchen
note: 210 xp each; approx xp/h range 275,000–285,000 without burns (lower bound used); cooking gauntlets reduce the shark burn rate when worn.

name: Cooking anglerfish
note: 230 xp each; approx xp/h range 305,000–330,000 without burns (lower bound used); cooking gauntlets reduce the anglerfish burn rate when worn.

name: Cooking karambwans (1-tick)
where: Rogues' Den fire next to the bank (also Myths' Guild or inner Mor Ul Rek)
note: 1-tick rates assume the Rogues' Den fire and 5,000 karambwan/h (up to 5,470/h at maximum); needs precise clicking; Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is required to cook karambwan.

name: Cooking karambwans (AFK, Hosidius kitchen)
where: Hosidius kitchen up to level 96, then Rogues' Den
note: AFK rates assume 1,385 karambwan/h at Hosidius up to level 96 and 1,435/h at Rogues' Den after; the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary grants Hosidius range access; the page recommends this as the best non-tick method up to level 96.

name: Buying and 1-tick cooking karambwans (UIM)
where: Tiadeche's karambwan stall; fire lit inside Tiadeche's hut on a second account
note: UIM guide 1-tick rates assume 2,105 fish/h (its AFK column, 92,800 at 30 to 190,000 at 99, assumes 1,000/h); needs Tai Bwo Wannai Trio for the stall and an Item Retrieval Service for inventory space.

name: Catching and cooking karambwans (Ironman)
note: From Fishing 65 karambwans can be caught and cooked after Tai Bwo Wannai Trio; each heals 18 hp; no xp/h given.
